{{Top|leg}}
A '''Grab-Field Generator''' produced a [[tractor field]], which was capable of collecting ions from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and channelling them into the [[Microparticle Ion Accelerator]] of the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]. The company [[Trak-Tex]] manufactured Grab-Field Generators.
